entries.question: How much does shipping cost?
entries.answer: Shipping within Germany costs 4.90 EUR and is free for orders from 40 EUR. EU shipping costs 9.90 EUR.

entries.question: How long does delivery take?
entries.answer: We roast on Mondays and Thursdays and ship the next day. Delivery takes 1-3 business days in Germany and 3-6 in the EU.

entries.question: Where is my order?
alternatives: How can I track my package?
entries.answer: You get a tracking link by email when your order ships. You can also see the status under My account > Orders.

entries.question: Can I return a product and get a refund?
entries.answer: Unopened products can be returned within 14 days. We refund the purchase price within 5 business days after the return arrives.

entries.question: What are your opening hours?
entries.answer: Our café is open Monday to Friday 8:00-18:00 and Saturday 9:00-16:00. It is closed on Sundays.

entries.question: How much is a bag of coffee?
entries.answer: A 250 g bag costs 9.50 to 14 EUR depending on the origin. 1 kg bags start at 32 EUR.

entries.question: Do you grind the coffee for me?
entries.answer: Yes. Choose whole beans or a grind for espresso, filter or French press when you add the coffee to your cart.

entries.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
entries.answer: We accept credit card, PayPal and bank transfer. Business customers can pay by invoice.

entries.question: Do you offer a coffee subscription?
alternatives: How do I cancel my subscription?
entries.answer: Yes, you get a fresh bag every 2 or 4 weeks. You can pause or cancel any time under My account > Subscription.

entries.question: Do your products contain allergens?
entries.answer: Our coffee contains no allergens. For pastries in the café, ask the staff for the allergen list.

entries.question: Do you sell to cafés and offices?
entries.answer: Yes, we supply cafés and offices. Write to hello@example.com with your expected monthly volume and we will send an offer.
